purpose: Select and reveal only the module needed for the person's chosen task, with explicit safety and return gates.

activation.implicit_trigger: A single relevant option may be offered only when it materially helps the stated task; wait for selection.

disclosure_levels.name: start
disclosure_levels.surface: one task, plain words, one sufficient step

disclosure_levels.name: domain
disclosure_levels.surface: one or more user-selected life or work areas

disclosure_levels.name: game
disclosure_levels.surface: optional lore and reflection; explicit opt-in

disclosure_levels.name: tools
disclosure_levels.surface: selected Obsidian, agent, script, or integration

disclosure_levels.name: system_design
disclosure_levels.surface: deep audit or architecture; explicit request

transition_rules.OFF_to_AVAILABLE: Module is present and its dependencies are known; no data access is implied.
transition_rules.AVAILABLE_to_PROPOSED: It materially helps the stated task and one-sentence usefulness is shown.
transition_rules.SELECTED_to_ENABLED: Required permissions, privacy, rights, dependencies, compatibility, and rollback are checked.
transition_rules.any_to_HOLD: A material permission, safety, rights, or compatibility condition is unknown or fails.
transition_rules.ENABLED_to_PAUSED: Person asks to pause or current task ends and module is session-scoped.
transition_rules.ENABLED_to_REMOVED: Person requests removal; preserve user-authored data and verify links first.

game.activation: explicit request or explicit stored preference
game.next_level: Show choices only after the person asks to continue; never infer readiness or inner evolution.
game.personal_artifact: A pearl is owned by the person; sharing is separate and optional.
game.sensitive_contexts: Do not use game as substitute for medical, crisis, safety, or professional support.

package_extensions.payment_or_entitlement: not-connected unless a verified service and published terms exist
package_extensions.machine_agent_may_expand: Only the selected module and only within the open package contract; show plan and wait before writing.

artifact_review.scope: Every created, revised, installed, or released SUTI artifact in open, Plus, and Pro packages.
artifact_review.default: quiet_review; no surprise user-facing persona or challenge
artifact_review.inheritance: Plus and Pro extend presentation or support; the same core audit applies to every tier.

provider_boundary.does_not_grant: file_access, account_access, connector_access, network_access, SUTI_tier_entitlement, or external_action_permission
